reference: Actual original GGML F32 SiLU and scaled softmax graphs; one CPU thread, original padded-row views. No Rust result used.
notes: MSVC uses scalar expf; GNU's default SSE2 macro selects four-lane prefixes with scalar tails.
Widths straddle four-lane boundaries, with row padding, two batch axes, scaled softmax and masked/underflow ranges.

Softmax uses an explicit original GGML CONT node after its padded input view, because the source constructor requires contiguous input. The initial noncontiguous-construction assertion is preserved externally.
Softmax uses the source F64 reciprocal converted to F32 once, then F32 scaling.
No expected-value tolerance or Rust substitution is applied.
